input.title: Data Engineer
input.descriptionText:
Fenwick Pay is a regulated payments company based in London.

This is a hybrid role: you'll be in our London office 3 days a week, with the rest of the week working from home.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines with Airflow and Kafka
- Model data in Snowflake and dbt

What you'll need
- Strong SQL and Python
- Experience with data modelling
- You must have the right to work in the UK
